sections.heading: What is trending: “künstliche intelligenz”
paragraphs: “künstliche intelligenz” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for AT (snapshot taken 2026-11-22T19:38:54+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 100 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Sun, 22 Nov 2026 09:50:00 -0800. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-11-22T19:38:54+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-11-22T19:39:21+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.
